preconditions.description: The city dimensions n and m are between 2 and 2000, and the time w to move between unoccupied cells is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell (i, j) in the city grid contains a value between -1 and 10^9.
The starting cell (1, 1) and the ending cell (n, m) are free (value 0).

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no path exists) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum time to reach the school.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value == min_time_to_reach_school(a, n, m, w))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum time it will take Dima to get to school, or -1 if it is not possible.
